_comment: issue #1693 AC4 — static routing cases for the create-issue Step 3 quality-guidance router. Each case names a drafting scenario, the observable facts a group's trigger keys on, and which quality groups the router loads. `kind` is core-only | positive | negative | uncertain; `group` is the group the case exercises (null for core-only). lib/test/modules/create-issue-contract.sh asserts this set covers a core-only draft, one positive and one negative case for every group, and an uncertain-applicability case (which loads its group in full). Group stems: quality-group-visual, quality-group-contracts, quality-group-premises, quality-group-semantic, quality-group-regression.

cases.scenario: A self-contained internal refactor: no user-visible UI, acceptance criteria with no number/comparison/quantifier/enumeration/trust-boundary, no external or Verified: premise, no new LLM/semantic judgment, and a feature (not a defect) with no case matrix or new external-input reader.
Add an Export-as-PDF button to the results page (a user-visible UI change).
Rename a CLI-only config key; no user-visible UI surface.
An acceptance criterion imposes a byte ceiling measured by a named counter.
Acceptance criteria are plain behavioral assertions with no number, value comparison, universal quantifier, enumerated list, or trust boundary.
The Desired Behavior relies on a GitHub webhook delivery behavior (external third-party premise).
A self-contained internal change that states no external premise and carries no Verified: bullet.
The change designs a new LLM judgment over PR comment text whose output drives an automated action.
No LLM or semantic judgment over third-party text; deterministic logic only.
A bug report describing a regression with observed and expected behavior.
A pure feature request that adds no reader of externally-produced input and enumerates no case matrix.
An acceptance criterion whose wording may imply an implicit threshold; whether it expresses a quantitative contract is uncertain. Uncertain applicability loads the group and evaluates it in full.
